title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft Student Financials / AR → ARTransaction

source_objects.description: AR item (charge/payment): BUSINESS_UNIT, CUST_ID (student), ITEM_ID, ITEM_LINE, ITEM_SEQ_NUM, ITEM_AMT, BAL_AMT, DUE_DT, ACCOUNTING_DT, ITEM_STATUS (O=open, C=closed), SA_ID_TYPE.
Item line detail with ChartField coding: ACCOUNT, FUND_CODE, DEPTID, PROGRAM_CODE, MONETARY_AMOUNT.
Billing invoice header and lines (for non-student billing): BI_ID, BILL_DT, TOTAL_AMT, CUST_ID, BI_LINE_ID, CHARGE_AMT.
Student Financials accounting line: the GL distribution for each student charge/payment. BUSINESS_UNIT, ITEM_NBR, ACCOUNT, FUND_CODE, DEPTID.
AR payment: DEPOSIT_BU, DEPOSIT_ID, PAYMENT_SEQ_NUM, PAYMENT_AMT, PAYMENT_DT, PAY_METHOD.
Item type definitions: SA_ID_TYPE, DESCR, ITEM_CATEGORY (T=tuition, F=fee, R=room, B=board, W=waiver, P=payment, A=financial aid). Drives the charge taxonomy.
Third-party billing contracts (employer tuition reimbursement, VA, tribal). CONTRACT_NUM, SPONSOR_ID, MAX_AMT.
Student career term: links charges to academic term (STRM). Used to associate AR items with the right academic period.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Resolve to HELIX student_id. In PS Student Financials, CUST_ID often = EMPLID.
The specific charge type code. E.g., 'TUITION_UG', 'TECH_FEE', 'PELL_DISB'. Maps to PS_ITEM_TYPE_TBL for description.
Original transaction amount. Charges positive, payments/waivers negative.
ISO 4217. Typically USD for US institutions.
Cast to ISO 8601. The date the charge/payment hits the student account.
Resolve PS STRM to HELIX AcademicPeriod.
If charge covered by third-party contract.

notes: PS Student Financials is one of the most complex modules. Key tables: PS_ITEM is the master, PS_SF_ACCTG_LN is the GL distribution, PS_ITEM_TYPE_TBL classifies every charge type. The STRM (term) association comes from the item's academic career term link. Refunds flow through PS_REFUND_HDR → PS_REFUND_DTL. Third-party billing (PS_THIRD_PARTY_CONTRACT) is common for VA benefits, employer reimbursement. FERPA/GLBA overlap: student financial records are FERPA education records AND may contain GLBA-covered financial information when linked to aid disbursements.
